CLM-DEV-0081.statement: At equal delivered throughput, TDD-DVM with POLITE consumes up to 7% less power than full drain voltage under POLITE.

We evaluate the proposed scheme with a system-level simulator following the 3GPP 3D Urban Macro model.

The remaining gap to the bound stems from the resource load metric, which cannot identify the few slots that require the full drain voltage, and future work will investigate selection metrics closer to the actual power demand.
